name: reshape
description: Clean a dirty Excel Table into a new table: dedupe, unpivot, split column, coerce types, project columns

tools.name: reshape_table
tools.description: Reshape one Excel Table and WRITE A NEW SHEET only (never overwrite the source). op: dedupe, unpivot, split, coerce (single column), coerce_columns (apply inspect columnHints / format:auto), project, flatten_header. Table must already exist for most ops; flatten_header uses sheetName+range.

tableName.description: Excel Table name from ensure_table. Not used for flatten_header.

range.description: flatten_header: used range including all header rows and data, e.g. A1:Z500

headerRows.description: flatten_header: number of header rows (default 2). Handles merged cells via fill-forward.

op.description: dedupe | unpivot | split | coerce | coerce_columns | project | flatten_header

idColumns.description: unpivot: columns that stay. Default: first column

valueColumns.description: unpivot: columns to melt. Default: all except idColumns

attributeName.description: unpivot: name of the new attribute column. Default 属性

valueName.description: unpivot: name of the new value column. Default 值

separator.description: split: delimiter. Default comma. project merge: join separator (default empty). flatten_header: parent_child join (default _)

maxParts.description: split: max new columns. Default = max observed

format.description: coerce_columns: auto (infer from inspect columnHints / samples) or manual with columnHints

columnHints.description: coerce_columns manual: [{index, header, kind}] from inspect_table.columnHints. kind: id_text|datetime|number|amount|percent|plain_text

headerless.description: project: first table row is data, not headers (include it in output)

columns.description: project: [{as, from?, merge?, separator?, coerce?}]. from/merge use 0-based index, column letter (A), 1-based number, or header name

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 去重结果 / 反透视结果 / 拆列结果 / 类型结果 / 格式结果 / 映射结果 / 拍平结果
